Literature.title: Literature
Literature.bio: Graduate of the Film Department at Taiwan University of the Arts. Her screenplay won First Prize at the Ministry of Culture TV Script Awards, and she co-wrote on a Ministry of Culture-funded feature. Winner of the Global Chinese Student Literary Award and the Unitas Secondary School Literary Award; her poems appear in Wind Ball Poetry Selection, Chien Kun Poetry Quarterly and Ginger Flower Poetry.

Film.title: Film & TV
Film.bio: I graduated from National Taiwan University of Arts in film and television. My experience includes film development and screenwriting at Viralstorm Studio, leading a video team at Knowhow College, and production and post-production roles across film projects.

Portfolio.name: Sonia Chen

Portfolio.intro: I am Sonia, a Product Builder at CMoney. I turn ambiguous needs into product specs, interfaces, and working web experiences. My background in film and writing shapes how I make complex ideas clear.

builder.title: Product Builder
builder.summary: From an unclear need to a working product.
builder.bio: At CMoney, I connect product planning, UI/UX, and implementation. I have independently delivered finance-creator landing pages and worked with engineers on investment products, then documented repeatable workflows for other PMs and marketers.
builder.fit: For teams that need someone to turn an early idea into a testable product and carry it through delivery.

deliverables.title: Define the first version
deliverables.body: Clarify users, core journeys, requirements, and the scope of an MVP.

deliverables.title: Build and connect
deliverables.body: Produce interface prototypes, implement web experiences, and integrate APIs.

deliverables.title: Make delivery repeatable
deliverables.body: Document deployment and automation workflows so others can reuse them.

pm.title: Product Management
pm.bio: I translate ambiguous needs into executable specs and coordinate design, engineering, QA, and operations. My hands-on design and frontend experience helps me discuss implementation tradeoffs and test ideas early.
pm.fit: For product teams building a first release, improving a fintech workflow, or introducing AI into an existing process.

deliverables.title: Frame the problem
deliverables.body: Identify users, product goals, constraints, and the smallest useful scope.

deliverables.title: Align the team
deliverables.body: Turn requirements into specs, prototypes, and trackable tasks.

deliverables.title: Follow through
deliverables.body: Coordinate delivery and interpret product results in their business context.

fe.title: Frontend Engineering
fe.summary: Interfaces that connect design to real use.
fe.bio: I build web interfaces with React and Next.js, translating Figma designs into responsive pages and connecting APIs and application state. My projects span booking, gamified experiences, calendar integration, and fintech interfaces.
fe.fit: For teams needing an implementer who can discuss both the interaction and the product requirement.

deliverables.title: Responsive interfaces
deliverables.body: Translate layouts into interfaces that work across mobile and desktop.

deliverables.title: Application flows
deliverables.body: Connect APIs, authentication, forms, and state to the user journey.

deliverables.title: Interaction quality
deliverables.body: Consider loading, language, keyboard access, and motion as part of delivery.

ui.title: UI/UX Design
ui.bio: I work through user flows, information architecture, and Figma prototypes. In fintech and web products, I have designed interfaces and discussed data structures with engineers, connecting the intended experience to implementation.
ui.fit: For apps and web products that need clearer flows, high-fidelity prototypes, and design decisions engineers can use.

deliverables.title: Map the journey
deliverables.body: Organize the steps, decisions, and information a user needs.

deliverables.title: Prototype the interface
deliverables.body: Build Figma layouts and interaction prototypes for review.

deliverables.title: Design for delivery
deliverables.body: Discuss states and data requirements with engineering before handoff.

design.title: Graphic & Motion Design
design.summary: A visual idea, carried across formats.
design.bio: Formerly a graphic and motion designer at BTSE, I worked on product animation with product and international teams. My selected design work includes identity, editorial design, packaging concepts, and posters.
design.fit: For brands and products that need visual communication with a clear narrative and consistent composition.

deliverables.title: Visual identity
deliverables.body: Develop visual direction, typography, color, and applications.

deliverables.title: Editorial and print
deliverables.body: Explore layout, binding, packaging, and the relationship between image and text.

deliverables.title: Motion and narrative
deliverables.body: Bring film and editing experience into product and brand communication.

ai.title: AI Art & Creative Tools
ai.bio: I connect a film and writing background with applied AI product work. My relevant projects include Dreamake for AI video and content generation, and GenInk for human–AI long-form writing.
ai.fit: For teams exploring AI-assisted creative workflows and tools with an understandable user experience.

deliverables.title: Creative workflows
deliverables.body: Start from what the creator needs to make, revise, and review.

deliverables.title: Product experience
deliverables.body: Turn AI capabilities into usable steps, interfaces, and prototypes.

deliverables.title: Human authorship
deliverables.body: Keep creative decisions with the author and make the role of AI explicit.

literature.title: Literature & Screenwriting
literature.summary: Stories built with attention to language.
literature.bio: My writing spans screenplays and poetry. The screenplay The Last Samozai received First Prize at the Ministry of Culture TV Script Awards in 2023. My literary record also includes the Global Chinese Student Literary Award and the Unitas Secondary School Literary Award.
literature.fit: For narrative development, screenwriting, and creative products that need a writer’s understanding of character and revision.

deliverables.title: Screenwriting
deliverables.body: Develop narrative premises, character relationships, and story structure.

deliverables.title: Literary writing
deliverables.body: Work with language, rhythm, and imagery through poetry.

deliverables.title: Creative product thinking
deliverables.body: Translate firsthand writing problems into tools such as GenInk.

film.title: Film & Video
film.summary: From the story to the finished sequence.
film.bio: I graduated from National Taiwan University of Arts in film and television. My experience includes film development and screenwriting at Viralstorm Studio, leading a video team at Knowhow College, and production and post-production roles across film projects.
film.fit: For narrative development and video projects requiring planning, coordination, editing, or sound experience.

deliverables.title: Development and production
deliverables.body: Prepare proposals, research audiences, and organize production requirements.

deliverables.title: Editing and sound
deliverables.body: Contribute editing, color work, Foley, or mixing according to the project credit.

deliverables.title: Team coordination
deliverables.body: Bring experience leading a five-person team and coordinating more than 50 video productions.

photography.title: Photography
photography.summary: Composition with a story to tell.
photography.bio: Photography is part of my wider visual practice, alongside film and graphic design. This page currently shows its application in a Taipei-themed poster; it does not claim a separate photography commission or published series.
photography.fit: For discussing image direction and how photography can work within a broader visual or narrative project.

deliverables.title: Image and composition
deliverables.body: Consider framing, visual hierarchy, and the intended reading of an image.

deliverables.title: Across media
deliverables.body: Connect photographic material with illustration, typography, and layout.

deliverables.title: Project fit
deliverables.body: Discuss the brief and required examples before defining a photography assignment.
